steps.title: Keep the completed product and setup tree
steps.instruction: The selected setup configuration generates BIOS/game C from the owner’s inputs and builds the product under build-release/ by default. Keep the complete source/setup tree, toolchain, originals, generated output and the product’s BIOS/mods/assets/settings together. Existing project/build-root overrides remain upstream choices. Do not confuse the initial package’s ValkyrieRecomp.exe with the completed native game of the same name: the setup host starts the product as a successor and exits.

steps.title: Attach the native product directly
steps.instruction: Select the actual completed build-release/ValkyrieRecomp.exe, or the product at the installation’s already chosen build-root override. Use its complete product directory as working directory and leave arguments empty after upstream configuration. Review the selected program, working folder and arguments and choose Play when ready. The selected shared setup consumer disables forwarding in a full game binary with game dispatch; direct product selection retains the actual native session. Do not select the initial forwarding setup host, recompiler or diagnostic mode. Finish rebuilds outside a running session and quit the actual game normally.

steps.title: Preserve both discs, roster and memory cards
steps.instruction: Keep the full prepared tree, both original CUE/BIN sets, game.toml disc roster, remembered disc index/selection, settings.toml, BIOS/disc sidecars, input/mod configuration and all active saves/card1.mcd and card2.mcd or explicit slot/root overrides. Relative Windows paths anchor to the native executable directory. Upstream supports disc selection between runs; mid-session swapping is not established and is explicitly unfinished in the selected game configuration. Do not claim a complete multi-disc playthrough, merge cards or replace a populated product root with fresh setup files. No card migration, restore or deletion is performed.

steps.title: Keep component and ownership limits
steps.instruction: Retain exact psxrecomp PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, recomp-ui MIT, chosen BIOS, font, compiler and all other component notices; these do not license the original game or artwork. Only use a complete independently permitted player/component set. Upstream/player owns generation, rebuilds and replacement: preserve data/recovery and review/relink changed bytes after maintenance. Work-in-progress compatibility and hardware claims remain distinct from this attachment route. No native/installed, real-save restore, full campaign/disc-swap, Supported or managed lifecycle acceptance is asserted.

steps.title: Start any additional game sessions separately
steps.instruction: Ordinary Quit ends the current process. Only explicitly choosing Return to Launcher schedules an atexit restart after saves close: on Windows that restart creates a new process without waiting. Treat that successor as upstream activity outside the attached session. Close every actual player and reopened launcher before maintenance or another attachment; registration status does not establish successor adoption or termination. This preserves the optional feature and does not disable it with arguments.

steps.title: Review Play and retain external ownership
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact selected executable, established working directory and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. Removing registration preserves external files. Upstream and you retain one runtime-replacement owner; Portcove provides no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion. Close actual players and companions before deliberate maintenance, keep the old working copy and all effective data, then review/relink changed selected bytes.

steps.title: Preserve the whole copy and effective data
steps.instruction: Keep the whole creating package, original ROM and every effective external root. Windows defaults portable state beside the executable; GBRECOMP_STATE_DIR overrides state and GBRECOMP_ASSET_DIR overrides assets. Preserve rom.cfg, keybinds.ini, runtime_prefs.ini, imgui.ini, shantae.ini, .sav battery data, .rtc, .stateN, map/patch-specific data, mods, shader_presets, shader_cache, logs and backups. warnings: Use only a copy and components you are independently permitted to use. No acquired-source-to-binary, gameplay, real-save, installed-client, Supported or protected acceptance is established. listings.download_block_reason: Fresh acquisition of the selected bundled engine-fork scope remains held: THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md explicitly names the gbrecompiled fork as stating no licence of its own, separately from the parent gb-recompiled MIT and title PolyForm Noncommercial grants. listings.name: World War II GI (Raze)
listings.summary: Play World War II GI in Raze using your own original PC game files.

steps.title: Use your recognized original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own original PC WWII GI data folder, anchored by WW2GI.GRP. Keep its accompanying files. Platoon Leader is an optional separately owned expansion that depends on the base game; it is not required for this base-game entry. Raze searches installed Steam/GOG copies and configured game-data folders. Reuse a recognized copy; do not duplicate it unnecessarily. If it is not found, place a copy of its complete data folder beside Raze, or add its real location to GameSearch.Directories in raze.ini. Keep your own originals; no original game files are included.

steps.title: Choose Play in the upstream player
steps.instruction: On Windows, use the official Windows ZIP and select raze.exe with the extracted player folder as its working directory. Keep the DLLs, raze.pk3 and soundfonts together. Registration does not start the player; Play does. Raze may ask which detected game/edition to use, because the same player supports several games. For a fixed entry, Change launch details can use two argument lines: -gamegrp, then the local Windows drive-letter absolute path (for example C:/Games/...) to your WW2GI.GRP archive. Use Raze’s game picker for UNC/network paths; this fixed-entry example does not establish a POSIX/macOS path rule. Keep that archive’s companion files together.

steps.title: Keep the shared profile this game uses
steps.instruction: Windows normally keeps raze.ini in Documents/My Games/raze, saves under the system Saved Games/Raze folder, and screenshots in the system Screenshots/Raze folder; redirected Windows known folders can change those absolute locations.
